cases.title: Key Wrapping using AES Key Wrap and No Encoding
cases.rationale: 1.1 note section 14.1. Literal KEK and data key; the wrapped Key Value is the RFC 3394 section 4.1 AES Key Wrap known answer, an independent crypto oracle.
cases.triage: Case-assumption conflict, not reclassified: the example wraps with a KEK registered without an Activation Date (Pre-Active). KMIP 1.1 section 3.22 says a Pre-Active object is not usable for any cryptographic purpose, and the later 1.2 note revision (TC-141-11/-12) sets Activation Date before wrapping. The server answers Permission Denied (Result Reason 0x0C in KMIP 1.1).
